messages.en:
{07 06 00}Whoa there! Not so fast!
I can't keep up with you,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}I just need a little more
time to get myself
organized!
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Oot-oot! Mitte nii ruttu!
Ma ei jõua sinuga sammu
pidada, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}Mul on vaja lihtsalt veidi
rohkem aega, et end
kokku võtta!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Hey, hey, hey! Wait a
second!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 16 00}Don't you think
you're moving too fast?
I'm not really ready right
now. {01 00 00 0f 00}Give me a little more
time, will you?
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Hei, hei, hei! Oota
korraks!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 16 00}Kas sa ei arva,
et sa liigud liiga kiiresti?
Ma pole praegu päris
valmis. {01 00 00 0f 00}Anna mulle veidi
rohkem aega, eks?
